I've saved the new release process to project memory: run `make release`, which tags and publishes. It replaces the old memory, which said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag on `main` and let CI publish.

I couldn't find a `release` target in this checkout of the repo, so `make release` won't work here yet. If the Makefile change hasn't been merged, that would explain it. The memory notes to check that the target exists before relying on it.
